plan.notes: SOURCE: Official UND 2026-2027 Academic Catalog, Nursing (NURS) program PDF, 'Four Year Plan - B.S. in Nursing' (Total Credits: 121). All course titles and credits transcribed verbatim from the plan. Key: * = must be completed prior to admission to the Nursing program; # = must be completed prior to beginning nursing courses. Students are advised to meet with a Nursing Office of Student Services advisor regarding Essential Studies requirements. QUIRK: the plan lists PSYC 250 Developmental Psychology at 4 credits; recorded at 4 as published so the credit sum matches the published total of 121.
